create.name: Bryan Kest
create.bio:
Bryan Kest began practising yoga in 1979 as a teenager on Maui, in one of the earliest Ashtanga classes held outside India, and went on to study with K. Pattabhi Jois in India. He has taught since the mid-1980s and is widely credited with shaping the style that became known as Power Yoga. In Santa Monica he opened what his site describes as the first donation-based yoga studio in the Western world, and he later moved much of his teaching online through PowerYoga.com, a streaming library of well over a thousand classes led by him and teachers he has chosen.

His approach treats yoga as a personal search for balance rather than a fitness routine: he pairs strong, flowing sessions with slow, gentle and restorative ones, folds meditation into ordinary practice, and encourages each student to find the right measure for their own body and stage of life. Alongside the online classes he runs self-paced programmes, an eight-week online teacher training and one-to-one mentoring calls, and he still tours studios across the United States giving in-person master classes and weekend workshops. Short talks and question-and-answer recordings on his site set out the thinking behind his teaching.

courses.title: 30 Days to a New You
courses.description: A self-paced month of Power Yoga with Bryan: twenty-six classes, a rest day each week and four guided meditations. Designed as a way back into regular practice at any level.

courses.title: Holiday Sanity Challenge
courses.description: A six-week practice challenge that runs each year from Thanksgiving to New Year, to keep a steady routine of movement and breathing through the festive season. Open to Premium members.

free_resources.title: Q&As and Lectures
free_resources.description: A collection of short recorded answers and talks in which Bryan explains the ideas behind his practice, from what Power Yoga is to how to approach the mat.
